cohorts: Exactly the previously reported paired company-by-origin-month rows for 2022-2025 and the 2026 January-August origin months; no filtering or retrospective replacement.
prediction: At the first observed date after the origin month, assume the next calendar month's observed-close arithmetic mean equals the origin month's last observed close. Predicted percentage change = (last origin close / origin observed-close mean - 1) * 100.
metric: MAE in percentage points on identical stock-month rows, separately for each year and overall; report per-stock and per-target-month results without changing the sample.
selection: No model fitting, parameter tuning or test-driven selection. The 2026 results were previously inspected, so this is a diagnostic retrospective benchmark, not a new untouched test.
availability: Origin last close is assumed usable at 08:30 KST on the first observed date of the next month under the KRX typical next-business-day 08:00 release policy. Historical exact posting time and original version are unavailable.
limitations: Unadjusted close-price mean, no dividends or executable-return claim. Existing retrospective corporate-action exclusions and their selection bias persist. Existing point-in-time approval flags remain false.
